description: LAOLA Movement was founded in 2023 by Taty, a German born, Ireland based certified Pilates instructor with a love for movement, connection, and the outdoors. Her mission? LAOLA’s name is inspired by the German word for “Mexican wave” (La Ola) — a symbol of community, rhythm, and spine mobility (the core of Pilates!). It perfectly reflects the brand’s philosophy: to move together, to celebrate our bodies, and to ride life’s waves — on the mat and beyond. What began as a handful of outdoor classes quickly grew into a growing movement in the local community. Today, LAOLA offers a mix of outdoor group classes in summer , online sessions in winter , and one-of-a-kind Pilates events that bring like-minded souls together — from sea swims to paddleboarding and even Pilates with alpacas. Taty is YMCA accredited through Reformation Studio (Dublin), with additional qualifications in Ante & Postnatal Pilates (APPI, London 2024) and an ongoing focus on women’s health and the transitions women go through across life stages. Every class is led by her personally, blending technical precision with fun, human connection. Whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned mover, LAOLA Movement welcomes all genders and levels . Taty creates a space that’s equal parts grounding and uplifting—rooted in movement, laughter, and community care. Outdoor events include: Outdoor Pilates & Sea Swims (every Monday 7pm!) Beach Pilates, Sea Swim & Sauna (next one coming up in August) Sunset Pilates & Stand-Up Paddleboarding (next one coming up soon!) Hidden Reset: A 3-hour mini retreat with Pilates, breathwork, nourishing snacks, local wine, and… alpacas. Yes, alpacas. ( Next one coming up in April) “Pilates?! I thought you said pies and lattes” – A morning event with Pilates, followed by light breakfast and pastries. Yes, humor belongs in your wellness journey, too. 📍 For the latest class schedule and a healthy dose of Pilates inspiration, follow @laola_movement. 📩 Booking via Wunderbook or email: laola.movement@gmail.com or this link tree 🌊 Taty can’t wait to welcome you on the mat—or in the sea. Testimonials about LAOLA Movement From Alison: “ I love Taty’s classes. She brings energy, encouragement and fun to each class. Taty offers regular slots as well as pop up activities with a social element and outdoor classes on Paddy’s Hill and the beach. description: We offer a fun and thrill packed pack week of surfing. Each day’s two hour session will allow your children to gain confidence and skills in the water. description: Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week. Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age. We are proud to be More Than Just Football and while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop - the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination) - Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping) - Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns - Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level. Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions. Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this. Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level. The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage. The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

This is a caregiver-and-baby class, and the attending adult must remain with their baby for the full duration of the session. Please bring: * A towel or blanket for your baby to lie on * Any feeding supplies you may need * Nappies and wipes * A spare change of clothes for baby Babies should wear comfortable clothing that is easy to remove for massage. Massage oil will be provided. Please don't worry if your baby sleeps, feeds, cries or needs extra cuddles during class. Baby massage is always baby-led, and you're welcome to follow your baby's cues throughout the session. I look forward to welcoming you and your baby for a relaxed and enjoyable experience together.

description: ☀️ Do Your Dance Tots: Saturday, 10:15 - 11:00 (ages 2 - 4) - Newtownpark Pastoral Centre, Blackrock 🌟 Do Your Dance Tots – Where Little Feet Find Big Fun! 🌟 Perfect for tiny dancers around 2 years old (but younger kiddos are welcome if they're ready to groove)! 🎶 Watch your little ones light up as they build strength, balance, and coordination through playful, follow-along dances, interactive games, and joyful singing throughout the 45 minute class. 🎉 Every class is a mini-adventure filled with movement and music, helping your tots develop key motor skills while having a blast! 💃🕺 All children are welcome - Do Your Dance is a completely inclusive environment. Parents must stay on the premises for the duration of the class. What to Bring: Please dress your child in comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes. Make sure your little one brings a water bottle/drink with them. There’s also a water fountain in the centre and bathrooms available for use. Arrival Time: Please arrive 10 minutes before class to get settled and ready to dance. Can't make it? No worries! If something comes up, just let us know via phone (0877007298) or email (doyourdancefitness@gmail.com) 24 hours before class. We can’t wait to see your little one dance, play, and have a blast with us! 🌟
